Returns: the portal type getTo @Nullable public   @Nullable Location   getTo () For PortalType.NETHER , this is initially just the starting point for the search for a portal to teleport to. It will initially just be the EntityTeleportEvent.getFrom() scaled for dimension scaling and clamped to be inside the world border. For PortalType.ENDER , this will initially be the exact destination either, the world spawn for end->any world or end spawn for any world->end .
